description: This Dart source file contains the implementation of an AgentService class used in a React Agent feature of a Flutter application. It handles the core logic of a conversational agent, including message management, tool setup, execution flow, and interaction with chat services and external tools like file reading/writing, time retrieval, and calculations.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling agent-related errors with specific error types.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main service class implementing the core logic of the React Agent, managing message flow, tool invocation, and executing agent steps.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Public method to start the agent interaction process with user input.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds an agent step to the sequence, with automatic timestamping and listener notification.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes and registers available tools for the agent, such as file operations, time retrieval, and calculations.

methods.name: _evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates simple mathematical expressions received as arguments.

methods.name: _tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes a mathematical expression string for parsing.

methods.name: _pE
methods.description: Parses addition and subtraction in expressions.

methods.name: _pT
methods.description: Parses multiplication and division in expressions.

methods.name: _pF
methods.description: Parses factors and grouped expressions in parsing.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Executes a named tool action with given arguments.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into a tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses argument list from an action string.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content inside specific XML tags from the model's output.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Generates the initial prompt guiding the agent's reasoning process.
